text:
Anya: bringing up halo17b (int4) canary, seeing intermittent OOMs during long responses.
Devon: how intermittent? repro rate?
Anya: 4 OOMs in 6h across 3 canary hosts, all for >1200 token streams. not instant, memory climbs then spikes.
Sasha: do we have heap fragmentation traces or just OOM logs?
Anya: OOM logs + dmesg. attaching small snippet below.
Anya: ```\n[pid 12345] Out of memory: Killed process 9876 (redwood-runtime) total-vm:34567856kB, anon-rss:31000000kB
malloc_stats: arena 2 sized 64MB fragmented...
``` 
Mike: looks like arena fragmentation + KV cache growth. halo17b has bigger KV per-token for int4 layout.
Devon: any changes to `max_new_tokens`? that affects peak.
Anya: default canary config was 512. We set a few traffic tests at 1024. Those were the OOMs.
Sasha: hmm. two levers: reduce max_new_tokens default, or adjust kv-evict/trim heuristics and arena compaction frequency.
Clair: +1 on adjusting eviction. Current defaults are aggressive for larger models; need model-specific profile.
Devon: can we try lowering default to 256 for halo17b in canary fleet and enable periodic jemalloc purge?
Mike: try also `kv_trim_threshold=0.6` -> evict when cache >60% of allowed mem. current is 0.8.
Anya: I'll spin a canary with: max_new_tokens=256, kv_trim_threshold=0.6, jemalloc_background_thread=true and enable arena purge every 30s.
Anya: config snippet: ```\nmodel: halo17b-int4
serve:
  max_new_tokens: 256
  kv_trim_threshold: 0.6
  jemalloc_purge_interval_sec: 30
  prefetch.window: 8
``` 
Sasha: prefetch.window 8 seems fine for latency; reduces prefetch memory overhead vs 16.
Devon: also consider `kv_evict_hysteresis=0.12` to avoid thrashing.
Mike: note: we should not set kv_trim too low for chat workloads with many short turns, leads to cache churn. keep canary traffic similar to prod patterns.
Anya: running canary for 12h with synthetic long-token traces + replay of real chat. will report.
infra-bot: deploy start: canary/halo17b-int4-config-2049991150 -> 3 hosts
Sasha: if OOMs stop, plan to ship as default for halo17b; otherwise we iterate.
Anya: initial 2h update: no OOMs so far, memory profile smoother. peak down ~18%.
Devon: good. any perf regressions on latency p99?
Anya: p50/p95 unchanged, p99 +10ms due to more frequent evictions. within SLO.
Clair: create an eval to run across representative prompts to ensure quality unchanged after int4 quant.
Mike: opened eval ticket ML-4827, includes hallucination/score checks.
Anya: tentative rollout plan: set model-profile for halo17b: max_new_tokens=256, kv_trim_threshold=0.6, prefetch.window=8; monitor 48h then widen.
Devon: add alerting for kv_trim_rate and jemalloc_purges per host.
Anya: noted. I'll paste final canary logs + perf graphs once 48h done.
Sasha: nice work. :tada:
Anya: thanks everyone. will update in #eng-ml when we promote to Dedicated.
